tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && echo \"=== Home page SSR text (authed) ===\"; curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt 'http://localhost:3000/' | sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' | tr -s ' \\n' ' ' | grep -oiE '(SVA Studio|Dashboard|Cockpit|Inhalte|Anmelden|Login|studio|willkommen|\u00dcbersicht)[^,]{0,30}' | sort -u | head -15\necho; echo \"=== /admin/instances SSR (root host control plane) status ===\"; curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' 'http://localhost:3000/admin/instances'\necho \"=== /admin/users status ===\"; curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' 'http://localhost:3000/admin/users'", "summary": "Verify SSR renders real content", "security_risk": "LOW"}
